_comment: Lowercased name -> person_id to force an in-prose story link, or null to force the name to stay plain text. Read by _build/link_person_mentions.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Re-run generate_static_site.py after editing. Only add a mapping here when one holder of the name is overwhelmingly dominant in running prose and the alternatives are minor/stub entries; leave genuinely contested names (John, Mary, Joseph, Joshua, Herod, Zechariah) unlinked.
